name: illustration
description: Mascot-driven explanatory illustration family. A shared workflow engine (digest → shot list → per-image generation → QA → deliver) wrapped by per-character sub-skills, each with its own IP anchors and likeness-locked references, drawn in a shared crude hand-drawn pastel style. Ships illustration:alex (ShotClubhouse Sport Head — gold soccer-ball head, no glasses) and illustration:popa (pink blob with a notepad). Invoke the bare `illustration` skill to pick a mascot.
